sales-call-prep.description: Prepare an evidence-backed brief for an upcoming sales call. Use for account research, meeting preparation, or a read-only call brief.

interaction-sync.description: Turn one completed sales call into reviewed CRM proposals and an unsent follow-up draft. Use to log a call or sync meeting outcomes.

task-triage-speed-run.description: Review due, overdue, and undated sales tasks, propose grouped dispositions, and prepare approved unsent follow-ups.

pipeline-review.description: Review pipeline evidence, stale records, stage criteria and next steps; propose exact CRM corrections for approval.

forecast-weekly.description: Build a weekly evidence-backed sales forecast with reviewed buckets, target arithmetic and a ranked path to target.

pilot-usage.description: Analyze a pilot from configured usage data or supplied exports and prepare a reviewed usage report or PDF.

close.description: Prepare a signed deal for Closed Won and review provisioning, commercial fields and downstream handoff proposals.
